e.title: DAV claim_frequency
e.summary: 德国精算协会（DAV）官方车险定价代码：GLM/GLMM/深度神经网络/CANN/XGBoost 理赔频率对比
e.body: claim_frequency 是德国精算协会（Deutsche Aktuarvereinigung, DAV，5400+ 会员）官方工作组发布的机器学习定价代码，对应其经典报告《GLM, Neural Network and Gradient Boosting for Insurance Pricing, Part 1: Claim Frequency》：在法国车险（MTPL）组合上建模预测理赔频率，先做经典 GLM 与其混合模型 GLMM，再扩展到深度神经网络与 Schelldorfer & Wüthrich (2019) 的 CANN（组合精算神经网络），最后应用 XGBoost，并进行交叉验证与费率结构/模型稳定性讨论。GPL-3，Jupyter 教学代码。对 RIAA：车险定价 ML 的官方教材级范本，与 [[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[tweedie]]、[[insurancerating]] 互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[casdatasets]]、[[insurance-python]]。
e.verified_note: GitHub API + README 核实：DAV（德国精算协会）官方仓库，11★，GPL-3，GLM/GLMM/NN/CANN/XGBoost 理赔频率（Schelldorfer & Wüthrich 2019 CANN 实现）
e.summary_en: Official German Actuarial Association (DAV) motor-pricing code: GLM/GLMM/deep NN/CANN/XGBoost claim-frequency comparison
e.summary_hk: 德國精算協會（DAV）官方車險定價代碼：GLM/GLMM/深度神經網絡/CANN/XGBoost 理賠頻率對比
e.body_en: claim_frequency is official working-party code from the German Actuarial Association (Deutsche Aktuarvereinigung, DAV; 5,400+ members), companion to its classic report 'GLM, Neural Network and Gradient Boosting for Insurance Pricing, Part 1: Claim Frequency': claim frequencies are modelled and predicted on a large French motor third-party-liability portfolio — classical GLM and its mixed-model cousin GLMM first, then deep neural networks and the CANN (combined actuarial neural net) implementation of Schelldorfer & Wüthrich (2019), then XGBoost, with cross-validation and discussion of tariff structure and model stability. GPL-3, Jupyter teaching code. For RIAA: a textbook-grade official example of ML motor pricing, complementing [[machine-learning-pricing]], [[tweedie]] and [[insurancerating]]. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[casdatasets]], [[insurance-python]].
e.body_hk: claim_frequency 是德國精算協會（Deutsche Aktuarvereinigung, DAV，5400+ 會員）官方工作組發佈的機器學習定價代碼，對應其經典報告《GLM, Neural Network and Gradient Boosting for Insurance Pricing, Part 1: Claim Frequency》：在法國車險（MTPL）組合上建模預測理賠頻率，先做經典 GLM 與其混合模型 GLMM，再擴展到深度神經網絡與 Schelldorfer & Wüthrich (2019) 的 CANN（組合精算神經網絡），最後應用 XGBoost，並進行交叉驗證與費率結構/模型穩定性討論。GPL-3，Jupyter 教學代碼。對 RIAA：車險定價 ML 的官方教材級範本，與 [[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[tweedie]]、[[insurancerating]] 互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[casdatasets]]、[[insurance-python]]。
